project.name: NEU-CodeLens
project.description: Hệ thống đánh giá năng lực lập trình thích ứng sử dụng Mô hình Ngôn ngữ Lớn — LLM-Assisted Adaptive Assessment System for Introductory Programming Education at NEU Vietnam

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: React application entry point — mounts App into DOM root element

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root router component — defines 6 routes: /, /student, /lecturer, /project/:id, /chat/:id, /classroom

nodes.name: LandingPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing page with login form for students and lecturers — handles role-based redirect

nodes.name: StudentDashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: Student view — shows list of submitted projects, upload form, project status cards

nodes.name: LecturerDashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: Lecturer view — lists all student projects with scores, review buttons, stats overview

nodes.name: ProjectView.tsx
nodes.summary: Project detail page — tabs for Knowledge Graph visualization, Architecture Report, and raw metrics

nodes.name: ChatPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Chat interface for Q&A about a specific project's codebase — calls /api/projects/:id/chat

nodes.name: ClassroomDashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: Classroom analytics view — aggregate statistics, grade distribution charts, at-risk alerts for all students

nodes.name: KnowledgeGraph.tsx
nodes.summary: Interactive force-directed knowledge graph visualization component — renders nodes and edges from graph JSON

nodes.name: ArchitectureReport.tsx
nodes.summary: Architecture analysis report component — displays score cards, layer breakdown, patterns, anti-patterns, recommendations

nodes.name: UploadZone.tsx
nodes.summary: Drag-and-drop file upload zone for ZIP files — shows progress, validates file type

nodes.name: NavBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Navigation bar — shows user role, project name, links to dashboards

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: API client service — typed fetch wrappers for all backend endpoints (projects, graph, report, chat, stats)

nodes.name: server.js
nodes.summary: Express.js REST API server — handles project upload, async analysis pipeline, project CRUD, chat endpoint, stats

nodes.name: analyzer.js
nodes.summary: Core analysis engine — invokes understand-anything pipeline on uploaded project ZIP, extracts nodes/edges/layers/scores

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Vercel serverless function entry point — re-exports Express app for production deployment

nodes.name: 01_data_preprocessing.py
nodes.summary: Data preprocessing pipeline — loads S19 CodeWorkout dataset (373 students, 201K events), engineers 13 behavioral features per student

nodes.name: 02_early_warning_system.py
nodes.summary: Early Warning System ML pipeline — trains Logistic Regression, Random Forest (AUC=0.850), Gradient Boosting with 5-fold CV for at-risk student detection

nodes.name: 03_learning_trajectories.py
nodes.summary: Learning trajectory analysis — K-means clustering, learning curve visualization by grade group, RQ4 charts

nodes.name: 04_summary_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Summary dashboard generation — produces 8 publication-quality matplotlib figures and CONSOLIDATED_RESULTS.txt report

nodes.name: rubric_framework.md
nodes.summary: 3-Tier Rubric Framework — 11 criteria, 100 points: Tier1 Correctness (40pt), Tier2 Code Quality (35pt), Tier3 Computational Thinking (25pt)

nodes.name: experimental_design.md
nodes.summary: Quasi-experimental research design — 2 classes (~80 students), 15 weeks, Control vs Treatment with LLM feedback

nodes.name: research_proposal.md
nodes.summary: Full research proposal — 5 RQs, literature review gaps, NEU-CodeLens novelty claims

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README — system overview, architecture diagram, setup instructions, API documentation

nodes.name: bao_cao_do_an_KLTN.md
nodes.summary: Báo cáo Khóa luận tốt nghiệp đầy đủ — 88KB, 1780 dòng, 5 chương + kết quả thực nghiệm S19 dataset

nodes.name: research_paper_DRAFT.md
nodes.summary: Academic conference paper draft (English) — 7 sections, preliminary results, target SIGCSE 2027 / EDM 2027

nodes.name: backend/package.json
nodes.summary: Backend Node.js dependencies — express, cors, multer, adm-zip, type:module

nodes.name: frontend/package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend Vite+React+TypeScript dependencies — react-router-dom, tailwindcss, react-force-graph

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration — routes /api/* to Node.js serverless function

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration — React plugin, proxy /api to localhost:3001 in development

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.description: React frontend — tất cả pages, components, và styling. Giao diện người dùng dành cho sinh viên, giảng viên và quản trị lớp học.

layers.name: API & Service Layer
layers.description: HTTP communication layer — frontend API client và backend REST server. Handles auth, project CRUD, file upload, và chat.

layers.name: Business Logic Layer
layers.description: Core analysis engine — understand-anything pipeline integration, project analysis orchestration, scoring algorithms.

layers.name: Research Pipeline Layer
layers.description: Python ML research pipeline — data preprocessing, Early Warning System (AUC=0.850), learning trajectory analysis, visualization dashboard.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Config Layer
layers.description: Deployment configuration — Vercel serverless, Vite build tool, npm package manifests.

layers.name: Documentation Layer
layers.description: Academic and technical documentation — KLTN thesis (88KB), conference paper draft, rubric framework, experimental design.

tour.title: Bắt đầu từ README
tour.description: README.md mô tả toàn bộ hệ thống NEU-CodeLens: kiến trúc 3 tầng (Frontend React → Backend Express → Research Python), các endpoint API, và hướng dẫn cài đặt.

tour.title: Backend API Server — Trái tim của hệ thống
tour.description: server.js là Express.js server chính với 9 API endpoints. Quan trọng nhất: POST /projects nhận ZIP upload, giải nén, chạy analyze pipeline bất đồng bộ, và lưu kết quả.

tour.title: Analyzer Service — Tích hợp understand-anything
tour.description: analyzer.js chứa logic tích hợp understand-anything pipeline. Nó chạy full analysis trên codebase sinh viên, trả về nodes/edges/layers và các điểm số kiến trúc.

tour.title: Frontend Router — 6 Trang UI
tour.description: App.tsx định nghĩa 6 routes với React Router v6. Mỗi route tương ứng với một vai trò (sinh viên/giảng viên) hoặc một chức năng (xem project, chat, classroom analytics).

tour.title: Knowledge Graph Visualization
tour.description: KnowledgeGraph.tsx render đồ thị force-directed từ dữ liệu graph JSON. ProjectView.tsx tích hợp cả KnowledgeGraph và ArchitectureReport trong giao diện tab.

tour.title: Research Pipeline — Early Warning System
tour.description: Pipeline Python 4 module: (1) trích xuất 13 features từ 201K events, (2) train Random Forest đạt AUC=0.850 phát hiện sinh viên at-risk, (3) phân tích quỹ đạo học tập, (4) tổng hợp báo cáo.

tour.title: Rubric Framework — Khung đánh giá 3 tầng
tour.description: rubric_framework.md định nghĩa khung đánh giá 100 điểm với 11 tiêu chí: Tầng 1 Correctness (40pt), Tầng 2 Code Quality (35pt), Tầng 3 Computational Thinking (25pt).

tour.title: Classroom Dashboard — Phân tích lớp học
tour.description: ClassroomDashboard.tsx là giao diện cho giảng viên xem tổng quan toàn lớp: phân bố điểm, sinh viên at-risk, xu hướng nộp bài — tích hợp kết quả EWS vào UI.
